title: MEMORY.md frontmatter, memory/v1 (AIP-72)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of an AIP-72 memory/v1 item: one small typed assertion (user, feedback, project, reference) about a principal or its work, with a lifecycle. A third doctype in the memory layer: it neither absorbs nor replaces AIP-10 knowledge/v1 entries (curated, shareable wiki pages over immutable sources) nor AIP-11 lesson/v1 (distilled lessons from runs). A memory/v1 item carries the AIP-10 base fields (schema, slug, kind, title, updated_at); the remaining fields are the memory item shape and are OPTIONAL, so a writer that emits only the AIP-10 base fields and a writer that emits the full item both validate against the same schema. The markdown body (the `body` property) is unrestricted text.

schema.description: Discriminator for a memory/v1 document. Optional only to tolerate legacy items written before this doctype existed; a canonical memory/v1 document MUST set it, and when present it MUST equal 'memory/v1'.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (AIP-10 convention). Used as the item's path stem and cross-reference target.

kind.description: Item kind (AIP-10 convention). Common values are the memory types: 'user', 'feedback', 'project', 'reference'.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last content write (AIP-10 convention). A writer MUST set it when it creates the item and when it changes any field other than `status`; a status-only lifecycle rewrite (to `superseded` or `archived`) MAY leave it unchanged.

id.description: Item identifier (e.g. 'mem_qc8f407g'). Legacy alias for the AIP-10 path stem; when the base fields are omitted it takes part in identifying the item.

name.description: Slugified name, distinct from `title`. Kept as a separate field so a legacy item round-trips without loss.

type.description: Memory type. The closed type set from the memory contract; `kind` is the AIP-10-aligned spelling of the same notion.

description.description: One-line human-readable summary, independent of the body.

tags.description: Free-form labels. Scope anchors are carried here in their formatted form (e.g. 'global', 'project:acme', 'agent:assistant', 'pr:acme/app#42').

polarity.description: Feedback polarity. Present only on items of type 'feedback'.

lifetime.description: How long the item stays valid. Typical values are { kind: 'durable' } or { kind: 'while', anchor: { … } }.

status.description: Lifecycle status. A writer creates an item 'active'. 'superseded' means a newer item replaces it; 'archived' means it is retired without a replacement (decayed, or its anchor no longer resolves). Both are terminal: an item is marked, never erased. Absent means 'active'.

rule.description: Classifier rule that produced the item (e.g. 'classifier-confident', 'memory-file').

source.description: Where the deciding rule came from (e.g. 'builtin').

decidedBy.description: Which classifier/rule decided the item's shape and status.

evidence.description: Trust/impact accounting captured at write time.

mode.description: How the item was captured: 'live' during the session it describes, 'batch' by a later pass over stored transcripts or files.

producer.description: Who or what captured the item (e.g. a clerk, a migration, an importer). 'unknown' when the producer did not identify itself.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the source was captured or extracted.

capture.description: Who, what and how captured the item, kept apart from `provenance` (where the claim was observed).

body.description: Unrestricted markdown body of the MEMORY.md file. Not constrained by this schema.

kind.description: Anchor kind. 'agent' extends the conversation-contract set for per-agent anchoring.

number.description: Pull-request number for a pr anchor.

anchor.description: A scope anchor, used by `lifetime` kind 'while'. Loose but typed: { kind: 'project'|'contact'|'agent', slug }, { kind: 'task'|'session', id }, { kind: 'pr', repo, number }, { kind: 'global' }.

kind.description: Lifetime kind. 'durable' never expires; 'until' expires at `at`; 'while' lasts as long as `anchor` holds; 'session' lasts for the session.

sessionId.description: Session the claim was observed in. Omitted, never empty, when the source has no session.

ref.description: Opaque reference into the source (message uuid, file path, ...). Omitted, never empty, when the source has none.

extractorVersion.description: Identifier and version of the extractor that produced the claim (e.g. 'extractor@3'), so a reader can tell items from different extractor generations apart.

provenance.description: Where the item's claim was observed.

sourceKind.description: Kind of source the evidence came from (e.g. 'transcript', 'memory-file').

explicitness.description: Whether the claim was stated outright or inferred (e.g. 'implicit', 'explicit').

contradictsActive.description: True when this item contradicts an active item.

lifetime.description: Lifetime as computed for the evidence pass.

anchorsResolved.description: Resolved anchor labels in their formatted form (e.g. 'global', 'project:acme', 'pr:acme/app#42', 'session:sess_…').

ageHours.description: Age of the evidence in hours (may be fractional or negative relative to the write clock).

flags.description: Machine-stable flags raised during the evidence pass.

evidence.description: Evidence/trust accounting captured when the item was written.
